Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4513219 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN, and filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513219'. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
